preview.exploreReport:
## Exploration Report

### 1. Page Structure Analysis
- Target URL: https://www.xiaohongshu.com/explore
- The page is rendered with React and loads content dynamically
- Post-list container: `.note-list` uses a waterfall layout

### 2. Data Node Location
- Post card: `.note-item`
- Title: `.note-item .title`
- Likes: `.note-item .like-count`
- Comments: `.note-item .comment-count

### 3. Pagination Mechanism
- The page uses Intersection Observer for infinite scrolling
- About 20 posts load each time

### 4. Anti-crawling Strategy
> ⚠️ Request-rate limiting was detected; use 2–5 second intervals
- Simulate real user behavior
- Cookie lifetime is about 30 minutes
